Letter.Intent: Wants a new bell for the fire tower
Letter.Seal Color: Yellow seal, from the head of Kotobe Street
Letter.Body: The fire tower on our lane lost its bell in the storm. 21 houses stand inside a rope's throw of it, we have kept no watch for 4 nights, and the last blaze took 8 roofs before it was beaten out.

Claims: Kotobe Street has written in 5 times this season.
This seal belongs to Kotobe Street.
The last blaze took 8 roofs.

Letter.Body: My father carried a sword before the surveys and it hangs in our house still. We have farmed this ground 7 generations, 6 men of our line served in the field, and 7 neighbours will stand witness to it.

Claims: The River Hamlet has not written in this season.
This seal belongs to The River Hamlet.
